name: labs/sfinucane__sindri
title: Tektronix BERTScope bit error rate analyzer (sindri.tektronix.bertscope:BERTScope_TCP)
intro: Tektronix BERTScope bit error rate analyzer (sindri.tektronix.bertscope:BERTScope_TCP), adapted from sfinucane/sindri. It reads `identity`, `internal_temperature`, `running`, `detector_bit_count` and 6 more; sets `run_duration`; runs `start_run`, `halt_run`, `factory_reset` and `reset_detector_results`. `start_run`: start all systems within the BERTScope mainframe (RST 1). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/sfinucane__sindri --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/sfinucane__sindri --backend fake --mcp
